issue_context.title: Major performance improvements for IQFeed downloader
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

performance of the current IQFeed downloader is quite terrible. Did some comparison tests old vs new implementation and the gain is huge.

For the same command line arguments: 
```
--app=iqfdl --from-date=20200330-09:30:00 --to-date=20200403-20:00:00 --tickers=AAPL --resolution=all
```
OLD took 00:03:31.4001187 [old code.txt](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463368/old.code.txt)
NEW without concurrency 00:00:10.0323723 [new code.txt](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463367/new.code.txt)
NEW with concurrency 00:00:07.3408517 [new code - with workers.txt](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463366/new.code.-.with.workers.txt)

211 secs Vs 8 secs is about 27 times faster getting the same data without bugs because I found at least one. daily were not fully fetched using --resolution=all switch.

OLD data:
[old-daily.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463394/old-daily.zip)
[old-minute-20200402_trade.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463395/old-minute-20200402_trade.zip)
[old-second-20200402_trade.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463396/old-second-20200402_trade.zip)
[old-tick-20200402_trade.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463397/old-tick-20200402_trade.zip)

NEW data:
[new-daily.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463398/new-daily.zip)
[new-minute-20200402_trade.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463399/new-minute-20200402_trade.zip)
[new-second-20200402_trade.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463400/new-second-20200402_trade.zip)
[new-tick-20200402_trade.zip](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/files/4463401/new-tick-20200402_trade.zip)

What I did:
- integrated [IQFeed.CSharpApiClient](https://github.com/mathpaquette/IQFeed.CSharpApiClient)
- processing data with concurrent clients
- using temporary files to save data before processing it (memory usage)
- end to end IEnumerable (memory usage)
- out of the box milliseconds precision for ticks
- cleaned the code

Whats missing:
- Realtime implementation (will be part in the next PR)
- Remove dead code (will be part in the next PR)
